issues.quote: revenue rising 14.9% to $245.1 billion from $245.1 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: FY2025 revenue was about $281.7 billion, not $245.1 billion; the $245.1 billion is the FY2024 figure. The 14.9% growth rate only works with $281.7 billion.

data.summary: The fiscal 2025 revenue figure is wrong: it repeats the fiscal 2024 number ($245.1 billion) instead of about $281.7 billion. Net income, operating cash flow, total assets, total liabilities and cash all appear correct.
